risk_note: Risk level per ops/risk-map.yaml (identity, admin/index.ts, app.module.ts). Admin personal-data-copy registration and list (BR-ID-40, CT-24q): one transaction locks the user row and decides in the contract's order (deletion processing 30419; an open request reused, except an undelivered wecom_session whose registrant lost the rights, failed and re-created; delivery from the two channel facts or 30419 delivery_undecided; a new pending row with retry_of and due_at = 15th working day 24:00 +08:00), enqueues B1-27h's data-copy generate job and writes one audit row from which both channel facts can be read back. Display names are read after commit with the root handle (review r1 S2). The list never returns object keys, extraction codes or passwords. No amounts, no ledger, settlement or payout state; contract operations leave planned. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36), two rounds, red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent.
